year.label: 2001-2010 Saleen S7-R GT racing family; exact RaceRoom revision not established

records.real_world_identity_notes: RaceRoom's Saleen S7R is the Saleen S7-R competition family, a GT1/GTS race car derived from the Saleen S7. It is the same real-world family already represented by the curated Saleen S7-R GT1 record. The exact RaceRoom chassis year and gearbox revision are not established: period evidence describes early S7-Rs with H-pattern gearboxes and later cars with sequential gearboxes. The reviewed sources establish six forward gears and a physical race clutch, but do not support transferring the simulator's observed technique or wheel shape into the real-car baseline.
records.confidence_basis: RaceRoom officially lists Saleen S7R in its GTR 1 class. Saleen's own racing history identifies the S7R as its race version and dates its inaugural competition season to 2001; specialist technical reporting identifies a six-speed sequential S7-R revision introduced in 2002, while a period MotorTrend drive documents an early S7R with a six-speed straight-cut race transmission and short-throw shifter. DailySportscar records the family transition from early H-pattern to later sequential gearboxes. The checked-out repository already contains the compatible curated record saleen-s7-r-gt1, so this observation should join that record rather than create a duplicate.
